title: JSONPlaceholder
responseShape: A top-level array of objects; a post has userId, id, title, and body.
rateLimit: None published; be polite. Writes are accepted and answered but never saved.

title: DummyJSON

endpoints.description: Products, 30 per page by default; ?limit=8 asks for eight

responseShape: An object { products, total, skip, limit }; each product has id, title, description, category, price, rating, stock, and more.
rateLimit: About 100 requests per window per address, reported in the x-ratelimit-limit and x-ratelimit-remaining response headers.

title: Open Library search

endpoints.description: Books matching ?q=javascript; add &limit=10 and &fields=key,title,author_name,first_publish_year to keep responses small

responseShape: An object { numFound, start, docs }; each doc has key, title, author_name (an array), and first_publish_year.
rateLimit: About one request per second for anonymous clients; search can take several seconds, so expect a long pending state.

title: TVMaze search
responseShape: Search answers a top-level array of { score, show }; a show has id, name, genres, premiered, rating.average, and image.
rateLimit: At least 20 calls every 10 seconds per address; more than that may answer 429.

title: Art Institute of Chicago
responseShape: An object { pagination, data, info, config }; each item in data has id, title, artist_display, and image_id.
rateLimit: 60 requests per minute per address for anonymous clients.
